hypothesis: At completed H1 boundaries, a first zero-crossing of broad USD-strength plus JPY-weakness pressure with at least 75% cross-pair directional agreement continues over the next four hours.
entry_rules: At minute 00 only: BUY when strength_usdjpy_pressure_1h crosses from <=0 to >0 and strength_all_agreement_1h>=0.75; SELL when pressure crosses from >=0 to <0 and agreement<=0.25. One position at a time.
exit_rules: Existing expected-R labels: SL 2 ATR, TP 3 ATR, maximum 48 M5 bars, actual-R time exit.
cost_assumptions: Existing label spread plus an additional conservative 0.05R per trade; no zero-cost substitution.
fold_definition: The same four fixed chronological test folds used by prior protocol-period experiments; validation windows are skipped and never used for selection; 48 M5 rows removed at each test end.
acceptance_criteria: All existing protocol gates: >=200 trades, >=3/4 positive folds, cost-adjusted PF>=1.20, mean-R 95% lower bound>0, max DD<=15R, no excessive fold/month/direction concentration, preregistered neighbors 2/3 and 5/6 show the same positive tendency, leakage audit passes.
rejection_criteria: Reject if any acceptance gate fails. Neighbor results cannot replace the 0.75 primary.
stopping_criteria: Stop this experiment after the fixed primary and preregistered robustness-only neighbors are evaluated; do not tune from results.
